metadata.question: Was the vegetation cover around Depok lower in 2019 than in 1990?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Landsat surface reflectance (Collection 2, Level 2). For 1990: LT05; for 2019: LC08. Time window: dry season (June 1–Oct 1) to reduce cloudiness. Region: 15 km buffer around Depok, Indonesia (Point [106.83, -6.39]). Fallbacks: widen date to full year; then try alternate collections (LT04 for 1990; LE07 or Sentinel-2 SR for 2019). 2. Masking strategy: Mask clouds, shadows, cirrus, dilated clouds, and snow using QA_PIXEL for Landsat; for Sentinel-2, mask using SCL (keep vegetation, bare soil, water). Compute median composite, then NDVI. Vegetation cover defined as fraction of pixels with NDVI > 0.3. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: - If no images after attempts: C1. - If valid pixel count after masking is 0: C2. - If veg fraction is null/NaN or outside [0,1]: C3. - Catch runtime errors (band names, memory): D. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const depokPt = ee.Geometry.Point([106.83, -6.39]); const region = depokPt.buffer(15000); // 15 km around Depok const scale = 1000; // use coarse scale to keep processing robust const maxPixels = 1e9; const ndviThresh = 0.3; // vegetation threshold // Helper: Landsat prep (scale + mask) function prepLandsat(image, redBand, nirBand) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0)) // cirrus .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0)) // cloud .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)) // cloud shadow .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).eq(0)); // snow const scaled = image.select([redBand, nirBand]).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2) .rename(['red', 'nir']); return scaled.updateMask(mask); } // Helper: Sentinel-2 prep (scale + mask) function prepS2(image) { // Keep SCL classes: vegetation(4), bare soils(5), water(6) const scl = image.select('SCL'); const mask = scl.eq(4).or(scl.eq(5)).or(scl.eq(6)); const scaled = image.select(['B4', 'B8']).divide(10000).rename(['red', 'nir']); return scaled.updateMask(mask); } // Build composite with fallbacks function buildComposite(year) { const start1 = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 6, 1); const end1 = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 10, 1); const start2 = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1); const end2 = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 31); // Candidates depend on year const candidates = (year <= 2011) ? [ {col: 'LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2', red: 'SR_B3', nir: 'SR_B4', type: 'L'}, {col: 'LANDSAT/LT04/C02/T1_L2', red: 'SR_B3', nir: 'SR_B4', type: 'L'}, ] : [ {col: 'LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2', red: 'SR_B4', nir: 'SR_B5', type: 'L'}, {col: 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2', red: 'SR_B3', nir: 'SR_B4', type: 'L'}, {col: 'COPERNICUS/S2_SR', red: 'B4', nir: 'B8', type: 'S2'}, ]; function tryWindow(cand, start, end) { let ic = ee.ImageCollection(cand.col).filterBounds(region).filterDate(start, end); return ic; } // Attempt seasonal window, then full year, across candidates let chosen = null; let chosenSize = null; let usedWindow = null; for (let w = 0; w < 2; w++) { const start = (w === 0) ? start1 : start2; const end = (w === 0) ? end1 : end2; for (let i = 0; i < candidates.length; i++) { const cand = candidates[i]; let ic = tryWindow(cand, start, end); const size = ic.size(); // Use getInfo here to decide quickly const n = size.getInfo(); if (n > 0) { chosen = {cand, ic}; chosenSize = n; usedWindow = (w === 0) ? 'Jun-Oct' : 'FullYear'; break; } } if (chosen) break; } if (!chosen) return {status: 'C1'}; // Prepare composite let comp; if (chosen.cand.type === 'L') { const red = chosen.cand.red; const nir = chosen.cand.nir; comp = chosen.ic.map(function(img) { return prepLandsat(img, red, nir); }) .median(); } else { // S2 comp = chosen.ic.map(prepS2).median(); } const ndvi = comp.normalizedDifference(['nir', 'red']).rename('ndvi'); return { status: 'OK', ndvi: ndvi, images: chosenSize, collection: chosen.cand.col, window: usedWindow }; } // Compute stats for a year function computeYear(year) { const built = buildComposite(year); if (built.status !== 'OK') return built; const ndvi = built.ndvi; const veg = ndvi.gt(ndviThresh).rename('veg'); // Counts and fractions const validCountDict = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const totalCountDict = ee.Image.constant(1).rename('ones').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const vegFracDict = veg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels }); const validPix = validCountDict.get('ndvi'); const totalPix = totalCountDict.get('ones'); const vegFrac = vegFracDict.get('veg'); return { status: 'OK', images: built.images, collection: built.collection, window: built.window, validPix: ee.Number(validPix), totalPix: ee.Number(totalPix), vegFrac: ee.Number(vegFrac) }; } try { const y1990 = computeYear(1990); if (y1990.status !== 'OK') { console.log(`1990: Images: 0`); console.log('C1'); return; } const y2019 = computeYear(2019); if (y2019.status !== 'OK') { console.log(`2019: Images: 0`); console.log('C1'); return; } const v1990 = { images: y1990.images, valid: y1990.validPix.getInfo(), total: y1990.totalPix.getInfo(), veg: y1990.vegFrac.getInfo(), col: y1990.collection, win: y1990.window }; const v2019 = { images: y2019.images, valid: y2019.validPix.getInfo(), total: y2019.totalPix.getInfo(), veg: y2019.vegFrac.getInfo(), col: y2019.collection, win: y2019.window }; // C2: No valid pixels if (v1990.valid === 0 || v2019.valid === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // C3: invalid results function invalid(x) { return (x === null || x === undefined || isNaN(x) || x < 0 || x > 1); } if (invalid(v1990.veg) || invalid(v2019.veg)) { console.log('Invalid vegetation fraction.'); console.log('C3'); return; } const validPct1990 = 100 * (v1990.valid / v1990.total); const validPct2019 = 100 * (v2019.valid / v2019.total); // Evidence lines console.log(`1990 [${v1990.col}, ${v1990.win}]: Images=${v1990.images}, ValidPix=${v1990.valid}/${v1990.total} (${validPct1990.toFixed(1)}%), VegCover=${(v1990.veg*100).toFixed(1)}%`); console.log(`2019 [${v2019.col}, ${v2019.win}]: Images=${v2019.images}, ValidPix=${v2019.valid}/${v2019.total} (${validPct2019.toFixed(1)}%), VegCover=${(v2019.veg*100).toFixed(1)}%`); const deltaPct = (v2019.veg - v1990.veg) * 100; console.log(`Δ VegCover (2019-1990) = ${deltaPct.toFixed(1)} pp`); // Final answer if (v2019.veg < v1990.veg) { console.log('A'); // Yes } else { console.log('B'); // No } } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
